bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the source composition of existing Yoruba datasets (e.g., Yorùbá Text C3, Wura) to identify the over-reliance on Christian missionary texts such as the Bible and JW300, and actively curating a new corpus to exclude these sources to prevent cultural imperialism.

Conducting quantitative word repetition analysis on existing datasets (e.g., discovering that 18.01% of the Wura dataset contains astronomical terms) and performing web domain distribution analysis on the new dataset to ensure a balanced representation of news, culture, and encyclopedic topics.

Qualitative evaluation of the dataset's composition limitations, specifically analyzing the skew toward internet-connected demographics, formal written language, and standardized dialects, which inherently underrepresents spoken Yoruba and informal variants.
